pipeline: Build a compact summary dataset from 279 EDF files (~20 channel-averaged EEG features)
Train a joint CTGAN on combined tabular EEG + genetic data
Apply biological constraints so records stay plausible
Validate with Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests and correlation checks
Use the synthetic set as validation only — never as fusion training data
interpretation: Synthetic genetic features are tightly constrained, so they match the real distribution almost perfectly. EEG summaries are the harder distribution. The records serve as a validation benchmark only — the final fusion model trains on real EEG embeddings, never low-fidelity synthetic EEG.
